rows.business_logic:
CTE chain (3 levels): cte_base → cte_enriched → cte_final
cte_base: SELECT customer_id FROM fdp_uk_customer_db.customer_detail WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE'
cte_enriched: pass-through customer_id
cte_final: GROUP BY customer_id
Value: customer_id
rows.target_table_description: Consolidated Data Product - customer summary with segment classification and aggregated product/balance metrics. Grain: customer_id. Built via 3-level CTE chain from fdp_uk_customer_db.customer_detail with filter account_status = 'ACTIVE'.

rows.target_column_description: Derived customer segment based on product count and balance thresholds
rows.business_logic:
CTE chain (3 levels): cte_base → cte_enriched → cte_final
cte_base: SELECT product_code, account_balance WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE'
cte_enriched: CASE WHEN account_balance >= 100000 THEN 'HIGH_VALUE' WHEN account_balance >= 25000 THEN 'MEDIUM_VALUE' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS balance_tier
cte_final: CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) >= 5 AND MAX(balance_tier) = 'HIGH_VALUE' THEN 'PREMIER' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) >= 3 THEN 'PREFERRED' ELSE 'CORE' END
Value: customer_segment

rows.target_column_description: Total number of distinct products held by customer
rows.business_logic:
CTE chain (3 levels): cte_base → cte_enriched → cte_final
cte_base: SELECT product_code WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE'
cte_enriched: pass-through product_code
cte_final: COUNT(DISTINCT product_code)
Value: total_products

rows.target_column_description: Average balance across all customer accounts
rows.business_logic:
CTE chain (3 levels): cte_base → cte_enriched → cte_final
cte_base: SELECT account_balance WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE'
cte_enriched: pass-through account_balance
cte_final: CAST(AVG(account_balance) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
Value: avg_balance
